content: alexcrichton removed the review request for wasmtime-core-reviewers from PR #14846.

alexcrichton opened PR #14846 from alexcrichton:no-panic-invalid-adapter to bytecodealliance:main:

It's possible for adapter modules generated to be invalid when the embedder specifically disables wasm features like multi-memory or reference types. Instead of panicking the compilation process in such a situation this instead returns an error with extra context at least indicating it was from the adapter.
